title: A Linear issue comment references a GitHub issue or PR number that doesn't exist
author: off-by-one
description: The ninth leg of the dangling-reference family (dangling-issue-reference watches commit messages, mention-dangling-reference watches X mentions, release-note-dangling-reference watches release notes, issue-body-dangling-reference watches issue/PR opening bodies, milestone-body-dangling-reference watches milestone descriptions, own-tweet-dangling-reference watches the town's own tweets, review-comment-dangling-reference watches a PR's own inline review comments, issue-comment-dangling-reference watches the ordinary issue/PR timeline), and the seam linear-comment-claims-unfixed-issue's own docstring named and deliberately left open: 'A named issue that does not exist at all is excluded here -- that broken reference is a future Linear-side dangling-reference recipe's own seam, not this one's.' This is that recipe. Extracts every same-repo #N reference (seam_engine.references.referenced_numbers, the one shared grammar eight sibling dangling-reference recipes already import) from a Linear issue comment's own text and checks it against both the live issue list AND the live PR list -- GitHub shares one number sequence between the two, so a reference must be checked against both or it would misfire on a perfectly good reference to a merged PR. Fixture-only, MOCK ONLY, same WIP shape linear-comment-claims-unfixed-issue already carries for the same toolkit.
confidence_notes: Age-gated by hours since the comment's own created_at, holding issue-comment-dangling-reference's identical 0.85/0.55 edit-grace-window bar exactly (24 hours) -- a Linear comment, like an ordinary GitHub issue comment and unlike an immutable X mention, is a text surface its author can still edit at any time, so a reference caught within the grace window scores the lower bar (0.55) rather than the higher one (0.85) a same-shape but unedited-window mention earns (0.75, mention-dangling-reference's own flat score, no edit surface to gate on). A reference matching a real issue or PR (either tracker, GitHub's shared number sequence) is excluded at confidence 0.0, named not hidden -- the reference was simply good. A comment with no #N reference at all produces no candidate whatsoever, not even an excluded one -- it never claims anything about a second record, so there is no seam to weigh, the identical 'not an invite at all' exclusion every dangling-reference sibling already makes. No text in this recipe's own headline/detail strings ever names or grades the Linear commenter -- CONTRIBUTING.md's 'No grading, ever' law, same as every recipe in this engine.
